heading: Skills
description: Instructions your team reuses, kept as pages: how to review a pull request, write release notes or triage a bug. Pick one in the AI chat with /, or from an AI app connected to the workspace. Each skill is a page or database row; people see the skills they can open.
emptyHint: Any page or database row can be a skill: open it and turn on Use as skill in its ⋯ menu, or start one with New skill.
downloadHint: A ZIP with the skill's SKILL.md, for AI assistants that install skills

menu.hint: Offer this page as reusable instructions in the AI chat and to AI apps connected to the workspace

bar.label: Skill
bar.placeholder: Say what this skill is for and when to use it

chat.heading: Skills
chat.pickHint: Use a skill (or type / in the empty box)

errors.notAPage: Only pages and database rows can be skills, not databases.
errors.template: Templates and the pages in them can't be skills.
errors.inTrash: Restore the page from the trash first.
errors.tooLong: A skill's description may have at most {max} characters.
errors.notASkill: This page isn't a skill anymore.
